stay.name: Laqua by the Lake

packages.name: Flavor & Relaxation by the Lake
packages.includes: A night in a lake-view room or suite, gourmet breakfast, and the Brezza tasting menu dinner at the one-star restaurant (drinks not included)

packages.name: Lake Experience
packages.includes: Two nights in a lake-view room or suite, breakfast, dinner at the lake-view restaurant with the Acquolina tasting menu and wine pairings, a sunset Riva boat trip, a 50-minute couples massage and a beach club afternoon

packages.name: Easter on Lake Orta
packages.includes: Two nights in a room or suite with buffet breakfast, the Brezza four-course tasting menu dinner at the one-star restaurant (drinks not included) and an 80-minute couples massage

stay.note: A lake resort of 14 suites, 5 comfort rooms, 2 penthouses and a separate boathouse suite.
